posts.text: I cast my vote in Kentucky. Grateful for the freedom to participate in self-government and thankful for everyone working the polls today. If you haven’t voted yet, make a plan and get out there and vote early or on Election Day, this Tuesday, May 19.

Today, a CIA whistleblower sat before my committee and confirmed what I've said for years: government officials, including Dr. Fauci, deliberately misled the American people about the origins of COVID-19. This is not a conspiracy theory. This is sworn testimony. 🧵

Six years later, millions of people are dead. Trillions of dollars were spent. Our civil liberties were shredded by mandates and lockdowns. And the man at the center of it all has never faced a single consequence. That ends now.
The American people funded this research. They were lied to about it. They deserve full transparency and real accountability. I will not stop until they get it. The fight for truth goes on.
